description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'EntityComparisonOperator' which provides comparison operations for entity conditions, including SQL generation, comparison logic, and pattern matching, within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityComparisonOperator
classes.description: An abstract class providing comparison operations for entity conditions, including SQL generation, comparison logic, and pattern matching within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: makeOroPattern
methods.description: Creates a Perl5 regex pattern from a SQL LIKE pattern string by escaping special characters and converting wildcards.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Validates the SQL representation of the left and right operands of the comparison.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Generates SQL for the comparison, handling special cases like IN operator with empty RHS.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the operands are empty; always returns false in this implementation.

methods.name: makeRHSWhereString
methods.description: Constructs the RHS part of the SQL WHERE clause.

methods.name: makeRHSWhereStringValue
methods.description: Constructs the RHS value part of the SQL WHERE clause.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Abstract method to compare two operands; implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the comparison in a given context, returning a Boolean.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Checks if the operands match given a data map and delegator.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Creates an immutable or frozen version of the operands.

methods.name: EntityComparisonOperator
methods.description: Constructor for the comparison operator, initializing with an ID and code.

methods.name: compareEqual
methods.description: Static method to compare two Comparable objects for equality.

methods.name: compareNotEqual
methods.description: Static method to compare two Comparable objects for inequality.

methods.name: compareGreaterThan
methods.description: Static method to check if one Comparable is greater than another.

methods.name: compareGreaterThanEqualTo
methods.description: Static method to check if one Comparable is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: compareLessThan
methods.description: Static method to check if one Comparable is less than another.

methods.name: compareLessThanEqualTo
methods.description: Static method to check if one Comparable is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: compareIn
methods.description: Static method to check if a value is in a collection or equals another value.

methods.name: compareLike
methods.description: Static method to check if a string matches a pattern similar to SQL LIKE.
